title: Pdfly: fpdf2 implicitly loads external URLs and local image paths when rendering attacker-controlled content…
description: The pdfly library (fpdf2) implicitly dereferences image resource references when rendering content, which can lead to outbound HTTP(S) requests or local file access attempts if untrusted input is processed. This affects applications that render untrusted HTML, SVG, or image paths without sanitization. The issue can enable Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) and limited local file access depending on the image parsing success. A fix is available in version 0.5.1_25.
